decisions.reason: As a multi-model range that moved from a mention to its own page and fits the firm's design-led core offer, management is likely to stay committed and treat any weaker demand as temporary rather than exit quickly.

This shower channel is highly central to the firm's barrier-free, seamless bathroom strategy and has had visible website support since launch, so sunk development and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

Although pump-assisted drainage appears less proven and the earlier related offer was removed, launching this successor shows continued commitment to the concept, so management would more likely persist for another year than drop it immediately.
